_about: KW-71 backfill: 'PROPOSED' impacts are Claude Code's proposals for the Quality Manager to confirm or correct (remove the word PROPOSED in Excel, or tell Claude Code); the others are confirmed from the item's own record (a QM-001 ref or 'no requirement changed'). 'register' lists the refs the manual already carries.
